The [[Travelling Jindas]], a troupe of entertainers on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], traveled with a menagerie of creatures, including a '''purple creature'''. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], two [[Dulok/Legends|Duloks]]&mdash;[[Unidentified Dulok (X)|one with an X on his chest]] and [[Unidentified Dulok (O)|another with an O]]&mdash;encountered the creature after failing to kidnap the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Latara/Legends|Latara]].
